LanguageData.ARIOIAF_DrownedGodDeityType: god of the sea and of the drowned
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_DrownedGodNarrative: Beneath the waves the Drowned God made the Ironborn in his own likeness, to reave and to rove, to carve out kingdoms with fire and sword. He drowned the first of them and raised them up again, harder than the sea that killed them.\n\nThe Storm God dwells in the clouded halls of the sky and hates all men, and between the two there has been war since the world began. What is dead may never die, but rises again, harder and stronger.
